name: cnki-search
description: Visible-browser CNKI search with manual WebVPN login, conservative rate limits, structured export, and authorized downloads.

tools.name: cnki_status
tools.description: Check session status without opening a browser.

tools.name: cnki_login
tools.description: Open the visible HHU WebVPN page for manual login.

tools.name: cnki_search
tools.description: Run an advanced or professional CNKI search in the visible page.

tools.name: cnki_fetch_details
tools.description: Read up to ten user-selected detail pages serially.

tools.name: cnki_export
tools.description: Export current records in five bibliographic formats.

tools.name: cnki_download
tools.description: Download up to five user-selected papers using official page controls.

tools.name: cnki_close_session
tools.description: Close the browser and discard the in-memory session.
